src/app-config/app-config.service.ts: assembles /app/config from config.app, the origin lists and the mini-app registry with no decision of its own; app-config.routes.test.ts pins the whole body
src/building/building.service.ts: pure delegation: building's door for other features (ADR 0010, D1), forwarding each call to BuildingRepository unchanged; building.repository.spec.ts pins the reads
src/miniapps/miniapps.service.ts: pure delegation: the mini-app registry's door (ADR 0010 D1), each method one statement forwarding to the registry `miniapps.config.ts` loads, whose spec pins the parse, the sort and the origin owners, or to a `miniapps.rules.ts` or `miniapps.mapper.ts` function its own spec covers
src/ui/campus/ui-campus.service.ts: delegation: reads the banners once through ui-campus.config.ts (its spec) and hands them to toCampusSheet (ui-campus.mapper.spec.ts) with the clock's time and the web view origin
src/ui/home/ui-home.service.ts: delegation: reads the layout once through ui-home.config.ts (its spec) and hands it to toHomeLayout (ui-home.mapper.spec.ts) with the clock's time and the registry's logo resolver
src/ui/scroll/ui-scroll.service.ts: pure delegation: hands the language and the web view origin to toScrollCards, which ui-scroll.mapper.spec.ts covers
